# Scenario: enabled=false downs that project and stops proxy routing.
# Sibling project keeps answering; curl to the disabled inbound port fails.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: keep + drop projects enabled'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# --- Cycle 1: both projects routable ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-keep-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-drop-web
exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-keep.conf
exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-drop.conf
grep 'listen 9999' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-keep.conf
grep 'listen 9998' $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-drop.conf

exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9999/
exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9998/

cd git-repo
cp ../settings.drop-disabled.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'chore: disable e2e-drop'
cd ..

# --- Cycle 2: drop disabled → down + no proxy ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
stderr 'down unused project=e2e-drop'

! docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-drop-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-keep-web
! exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-drop.conf
exists $HOME/infra/nginx/conf/dev_e2e-keep.conf

exec curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:9999/
! exec curl -sf --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:9998/

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-keep
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none
  - name: e2e-drop
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9998
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.drop-disabled.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-keep
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9999
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none
  - name: e2e-drop
    enabled: false
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9998
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-keep/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do echo -e 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n\n OK' | nc -lk -p 80; done"

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-drop/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do echo -e 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n\n OK' | nc -lk -p 80; done"

-- .env --
